name: BPM zero and negative
note: Capture native float and tick behavior with a disposable sequencer.
limit: Tick behavior after invalid BPM is not covered.

name: BPM float edge conversion
note: Check fractions, NaN, and values outside signed int range.
limit: NaN is not covered.

name: Pattern length zero and negative
note: Compare invalid lengths without using the main game sequencer.
limit: Tick wrap after invalid length is not covered.

name: Loop length zero and negative
note: Check wrap at the first boundary.
limit: Observed after 12 updates.

name: Note type outside 0 to 5
note: Compare unsupported note types at several current steps.
limit: Covers 6 and -1.

name: Time getter tick boundaries
note: Use controlled clock steps so exact values are repeatable.
limit: Raw clock values vary and are excluded.

name: Volume and pan effect
note: Compare audible output or a recovered native state reader; return values alone are shallow.
limit: Return values only; audio output is not measured.

name: Master pulse consumer
note: Trace reads of the retail global and compare the affected behavior.
limit: Return value only; no consumer effect measured.

name: Trigger overload type matrix
note: Cover supported int, float, bool, null, and wrong arity combinations.
limit: Supported forms only; bad types and arity are not covered.

name: Duplicate trigger coordinates
note: Check stable order after insertion and moving first, middle, and tail.
limit: Moving the last of multiple triggers crashes retail; see retail-crashes.md.

name: Restart at future step
note: Compare same-step callback ordering and one-shot removal.
limit: Callback order against same-step actions is not covered.

name: Callback mutation
note: Append, tag, and clear inside a callback; check staged dispatch.
limit: One append, tag, and clear path.

name: Action wrapper lifetime
note: Verify alias state after GC, trigger removal, and table replacement.
limit: Clear and explicit GC covered.

name: Trigger cursor during mutation
note: Check insertion and deletion while a cursor is held; avoid retail stale-pointer crash.
limit: Insertion and moving a held trigger covered; deletion is not covered.

name: Move trigger ordering
note: Check order after moving first, middle, and repeated positions.
limit: Moving the last of multiple triggers crashes retail; see retail-crashes.md.

name: Sequencer cursor during mutation
note: Compare visibility and ownership when a sequencer is created or collected.
limit: Creation only; collection is not covered.

name: Callback and GC interleave
note: Collect between trigger scheduling and dispatch.
limit: One explicit GC before callback.

name: Malformed packed sequence
note: Check short, sparse, oversized, and noninteger tables.
limit: Empty, short, sparse, and float entries; oversized is not covered.

name: Malformed sequence string
note: Check invalid prefix, invalid digits, embedded null, and long strings.
limit: Invalid prefix, bad digit, and long text; embedded NUL is not covered.

name: Object ID allocation order
note: Compare ID consumption by sequencers and trigger handles.
limit: One allocation interval.
